title: AsyncAPI v1.2.0 - Message
description: Describes a message received on a given topic and operation

$ref.description: Allows for an external definition of this message. The referenced structure MUST be in the format of a Message Object

headers.description: A deterministic version of a JSON Schema object

payload.description: A deterministic version of a JSON Schema object

tags.description: A list of tags for API documentation control. Tags can be used for logical grouping of messages

summary.description: A brief summary of the message

description.description: A longer description of the message. CommonMark is allowed

externalDocs.description: Allows referencing an external resource for extended documentation

deprecated.description: Declares this message to be deprecated. Usage of the declared message SHOULD be refrained
